query.title: Company or person name
query.description: A company/establishment name (or partial name) or a registered owner's person name to search for. Leave blank (with no 'queries' either) to instead browse the most recent filings on the register.

queries.title: Company or person names
queries.description: Multiple names to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

dateFrom.title: Registered from (date)
dateFrom.description: Only include filings registered on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combines with any name search above.

dateTo.title: Registered until (date)
dateTo.description: Only include filings registered on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Combines with any name search above.

orderBy.title: Order by
orderBy.description: Sort filings by registration date or by name.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of filings to return per search query (or, if no query is given, the maximum number of latest filings to browse).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many queries to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
